rect.title: <b>DISARIN211 Decision-making in AI</b><br>Introduces planning techniques for AI systems in deterministic and<br>non‑deterministic environments. Addresses uncertainty, partial observability,<br>resource planning and optimizing behaviour under constraints.

<b>DISARIN311 Optimization Methods in AI</b><br>Covers computational methods for search problems in complex and adversarial<br>environments. Includes uninformed and informed search, local and global search,<br>adversarial games and constraint satisfaction problems.

<b>DISARIN312 Reinforcement Learning</b><br>Explores reinforcement learning. Covers theoretical frameworks and algorithms<br>and requires students to implement algorithms and build agents using neural<br>networks that learn through trial and error.

<b>DISCOMP211 Networks & Operating Systems</b><br>Introduces computer networks and operating systems. Covers how the internet<br>works and the role of an OS in resource management and application support.

<b>DISCOMP213 Software Development</b><br>Covers software design, creation, testing and maintenance. Uses C++ and Haskell<br>and covers planning, requirements gathering, testing, deployment and maintenance<br>through discussions and code reviews.

<b>DISCOMP311 Algorithms & Data Structures</b><br>Teaches design and analysis of algorithms and data structures, emphasizing<br>performance analysis and focusing on prominent algorithms and data structures.
<b>DISCOMP312 Advanced Algorithms</b><br>Studies modern algebraic algorithms and optimization methods. Emphasises<br>algorithmic thinking and mathematical modelling of computational problems.

<b>DISDATA311 Neural Networks & Deep Learning</b><br>Explores theory and practice of neural networks. Students build basic networks<br>and progress to complex networks for computer vision, and discuss recent<br>developments in large language and image generation models.
<b>DISDATA312 Robotics</b><br>Covers computational problems in robotics. Includes forward and inverse<br>kinematics, motion planning, collision avoidance and robotic grasping and<br>manipulation.

<b>DISMATH211 Linear Algebra</b><br>Introduces systems of equations, vectors, matrices and linear spaces with<br>emphasis on visual and conceptual understanding. Applies concepts across fields<br>and includes hands‑on exercises using computer algebra software.

<b>DISMATH213 Computational & Numerical Methods</b><br>Introduces numerical methods such as root‑finding, interpolation, numerical<br>differentiation and integration and solving differential equations. Emphasises<br>algorithm accuracy, stability and efficiency and uses computer algebra software.

<b>DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus</b><br>Extends elementary calculus to multiple dimensions and differential equations,<br>including complex‑valued functions. Uses computer algebra software to deepen<br>analytical skills for science and data analysis applications.

<b>DISMATH312 Linear Systems</b><br>Focuses on analysis of linear systems from an engineering perspective. Explores<br>representations via differential equations, transfer functions, state‑space and<br>signal‑flow diagrams and discusses applications in control, signal processing<br>and modelling.

<b>DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics</b><br>Provides a foundation in mathematical statistics. Covers probability theory,<br>discrete and continuous distributions, sampling, parameter estimation and<br>simulation; uses computer algebra software to develop theoretical understanding<br>and practical skills.

<b>DISARIN111 AI Ethics</b><br>Explores philosophical foundations and implications of AI. Examines the history<br>of AI, ethical issues like interpretability, bias and alignment, debates about<br>AI consciousness and implications for human nature.

<b>DISARIN212 Logic & Discrete Mathematics</b><br>Focuses on mathematics of decision‑making, covering topics in discrete<br>mathematics such as logic, patterns and structures, with applications to<br>computer science and algorithm construction.
<b>DISCOMP212 Database Management Systems</b><br>Introduces relational database management systems and SQL. Covers relational<br>database theory, authorization, normalization and query processing.

<b>DISDATA111 Introduction to Data Science</b><br>Develops foundational skills in data visualization, cleaning and manipulation.<br>Explores spatial and text data and includes hands‑on work with datasets from<br>various disciplines.

<b>DISDATA211 Machine Learning</b><br>Covers core machine learning techniques from linear regression to advanced<br>tree‑based methods. Discusses strengths and weaknesses and applies methods to<br>real data from fields like medicine, physics and economics.

<b>DISDATA212 Image Processing & Computer Vision</b><br>Covers processing and analysis of image data, including feature detection and<br>tracking. Discusses applications in medicine, self‑driving vehicles, gaming,<br>robotics and traffic management.

<b>DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming</b><br>Introduces programming and computer science. Covers structured programming, data<br>constructs, testing, debugging and object‑oriented programming with Python, and<br>develops computational problem‑solving skills.

<b>DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods</b><br>Introduces linear algebra (vectors, matrices, eigenvalues) and calculus (limits,<br>differentiation, integration) to construct and solve equations. Provides<br>problem‑solving skills applicable across disciplines.
